The RB work got split near-evenly between Kyren Williams and Blake Corum. The starter carried 16 times for 99 yards and a TD and caught both of his targets for 22 yards. Corum posted a 17-93-1 rushing line and caught his lone target for 8 yards.

editorial.headline: Davante Adams: Rams TEs Get Busy Without Davante Adams
editorial.thread_title: [LAR] Davante Adams: Rams TEs Get Busy Without Davante Adams

evidence.feed_summary: Sunday marked the Rams' first game since losing WR Davante Adams to a hamstring injury, and they ran a lot of "13" personnel. That's the three-TE alignment the offense has become known for over the past two years, and L.A. ran it on a league-high 43% of plays in Sunday's win over the Raiders. Their 51% rate of 2+ TEs ranked sixth, and both rates marked increases vs. their season numbers. That meant 50+ snaps for Tyler Higbee, Colby Parkinson, and Davis Allen, putting the trio behind only QB Matthew Stafford and WR Puka Nacua in total playing time. Higbee led the trio in routes at 18, 56.3% of Stafford's total dropbacks. Parkinson followed at 14 (43.8%), with Allen at 12 (37.5%). Parkinson led the group with 6 targets, 5 catches, and 48 yards, ranking second on the team in all three categories (behind Nacua). Allen tallied 4 catches for 20 yards on 5 targets, while Higbee managed just 2 catches for 14 yards on 3 targets. No other Ram beat any of the TEs in targets.
evidence.original_title: Rams TEs Get Busy Without Davante Adams

editorial.headline: Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell Split Time; Matthew Stafford Doesn't Care
editorial.thread_title: [LAR] Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell Split Time; Matthew Stafford Doesn't Care

evidence.feed_summary: The Rams went without WR Davante Adams on Sunday for the first time this season. In his place, WRs Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwell saw near-equal time. Puka Nacua led the group at 61 snaps and 31 routes, 96.9% of QB Matthew Stafford's total dropbacks. Mumpfield led Atwell 31-25 in snaps, but the two ran a matching 20 routes (62.5%). Atwell went without a target among Stafford's 29 attempts, though, while Mumpfield drew only 2. He caught one for 15 yards.
evidence.original_title: Konata Mumpfield, Tutu Atwell Split Time; Matthew Stafford Doesn't Care

editorial.headline: Ashton Jeanty Looking More Wan'Dale Robinson Than RB
editorial.thread_title: [LV] Ashton Jeanty Looking More Wan'Dale Robinson Than RB

evidence.feed_summary: Here's the good news from Week 7: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty gave you a nice PPR score. He ranks sixth at the position in points ahead of the Monday night game. The bad news? He barely did anything on the ground, against a Rams D that was missing two starting DTs and its lead LB. Jeanty rushed eight times for just 15 yards in the lopsided loss, adding 8 catches for 61 yards and a TD on 8 targets.

editorial.headline: Kirk Cousins Keeps Getting There on Volume
editorial.thread_title: [LV] Kirk Cousins Keeps Getting There on Volume

evidence.feed_summary: Raiders QB Kirk Cousins delivered his fifth top-12 fantasy line among the past six weeks in Sunday's loss to the Rams. He threw for 295 yards on 26-of-44 passing, with 2 TDs and no turnovers. It was the second straight game and third among the past four in which Cousins attempted at least 40 passes. All thre of those games also found him completing less than 60% of his throws bue tallying 295+ yards. Cousins has hit 2+ TD passes in six of seven games for the year and currently leads the league with 16 scoring tosses.
evidence.original_title: Kirk Cousins Keeps Getting There on Volume
